explication: AIDD is an AI coding-tool SDLC framework, with a CLI that installs and manages its tool integrations and plugins. Its wider runtime includes marketplace distribution, content translation, telemetry collection/reporting, and a Kanban task view. The principal user path is invoking CLI commands to set up or install framework content for a supported tool; the manifest and filesystem adapters provide an internal persistence layer. Several product areas are represented by directory-level nodes because their implementation was not excerpted; README-backed links document capabilities, not inspected call chains.
